nodes.label: Scan for regressions
nodes.prompt:
TASK: Run the full test suite and the linter on the current branch and list every failure.
DELIVERABLE: A markdown list of failures with file:line, written to reports/{{key}}/scan.md.
SCOPE: Read-only. Do not edit source files.
VERIFY: The report file exists and each entry has a file:line reference.
STOP WHEN the report is written.

TASK: Read reports/{{key}}/scan.md and group the failures by probable root cause.
DELIVERABLE: reports/{{key}}/triage.md with one section per cause, ranked by impact.
SCOPE: Read-only. Use only the scan report and the repository.
VERIFY: Every failure from the scan report appears in exactly one group.
STOP WHEN the triage file is written.

TASK: Audit reports/{{key}}/scan.md and reports/{{key}}/triage.md for consistency.
DELIVERABLE: reports/{{key}}/verify.md stating PASS or FAIL with reasons. Run date {{date}}.
SCOPE: Read-only.
VERIFY: Counts of failures match between the two files.
STOP WHEN the verdict file is written.
